$Comment: MMO Skill Tree's half of the Harvest Set, Harvest_Feast_Harvest_Set.json. Joins adds this file to that
set instead of making a set of its own, so the player still sees one Harvest Set: one notice, one
entry. The set's name and members stay that file's, so this file names none.
Its two tiers ask exactly what the set's two tiers ask (Armor 2, then Armor 4), so each joins its
twin: its stats apply beside the set's, and its line follows the set's line in the same notice. A
tier asking for something else would be added as a tier of its own. Requires takes this file out on a
server without MMO Skill Tree, where these stats do not exist and its lines would name a bonus nobody
gets; always write it with Min 1.
TrackGain_Harvesting raises the Harvesting XP the wearer earns and GatherYield_Harvesting the chance
of a bonus find on a hand harvest, the luck Harvesting's lucky rolls read, both in whole percent
